lead.en: Design the component language in Emfatic, from classes and multiplicities to containment, opposites, inheritance and enumerations.
lead.zh: 用 Emfatic 设计组件语言，从类和多重性逐步发展到包含、反向引用、继承与枚举。

prerequisites.en: Module 1, or a basic understanding of models, metamodels and conformance. Every example runs in the browser.
prerequisites.zh: 完成第 1 模块，或已了解模型、元模型与符合性的基本概念。所有示例都可以在浏览器中运行。

en: Write Emfatic classes, attributes and references for a small domain.
Choose containment, opposites and multiplicities deliberately.
Use abstract classes, inheritance and enumerations to remove duplication and restrict values.
Explain what an Ecore metamodel can and cannot enforce on its own.
Revise a metamodel and update a conforming Flexmi model.
zh: 用 Emfatic 为小型领域编写类、属性与引用。
有意识地选择包含、反向引用与多重性。
用抽象类、继承和枚举减少重复并限制取值。
说明 Ecore 元模型自身能约束什么，不能约束什么。
修改元模型，并更新符合它的 Flexmi 模型。
